findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice short questions for Unit 10 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 38 questions numbered 1-38; by section: 10.1 19, 10.2 10, 10.3 9.

Covers 10.1 (definitions, basic equations in every quadrant, special values, square roots with both signs, quadratics in one ratio, factorising instead of cancelling, extraneous roots, combining families), 10.2 (graphical method, radians, range limits, sign test, counting crossings, asymptotes) and 10.3 (angles of elevation, subtended angle with the tan^-1 difference formula, projectile range) in book order with new equations and data; no exercise question or book example is repeated. Book corrections followed (4pi/3 + 2n pi in Example 1, x = 0 not a root of cos x = x/8). Every answer was checked by computation (check10.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
